colleges.notes: Prospectus pages read from renders (PDF pp. 94-96; printed 'PROSPECTUS 2026 | 74/75/76'). These are the same figures as the SMIMS HTML 'Program FEES' pages snapshotted in round 1 (e.g. Gen Med 29,60,000 / 10,35,000 / 53,00,000; Radiology 35,00,000 / 11,70,000 / 66,00,000; Anaesthesia 25,00,000 / 9,20,000 / 44,00,000), so the HTML figures are the 2026 prospectus figures. Annual columns A1-A3 = one instalment per year of the 3-year course (bi-annual option B1-B6 at half, e.g. 15,39,000). Note iv says 'The Total Fee of Entire Course may be paid … Annual Payment … In 5 Instalments (A1-A5)' — printed so (generic). 'Course fee includes: Tution fee, Laboratory fee, University fee and Other fees'; examination fee extra; 1% p.m. late fine. Management fee printed only for Gen Medicine/OBG/Ortho/Paediatrics, Anaesthesia and Radiology. Seat mapping: our roster's 'Sikkim Gen Quota' = Category A General (Gen)/NE/Def; 'Sikkim Govt Quota' = 'Sikkim Quota' (Govt. of Sikkim nominated, 75% tuition concession); 'Sikkim Mgmt Quota' = Management. Seat matrix p.92 (MD/MS): General (All India) 21, North East NIL, Govt. of Sikkim Nominated 6** (in-service doctors), Management 5. The label is 'PROSPECTUS 2026' (no '2026-27').
